description: This file defines an interface and a class related to fault injection transaction coordination in the Orleans framework, specifically for testing transaction behaviors across multiple grains.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: Interface for a transaction coordinator grain that supports fault injection operations across multiple grains.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: Implementation of the transaction coordinator grain for fault injection testing, supporting multi-grain set and add operations with optional fault injection.

methods.name: MultiGrainSet
methods.description: Sets a new value across multiple grains atomically.

methods.name: MultiGrainAddAndFaultInjection
methods.description: Adds a value to multiple grains, with optional fault injection.
